mod.name: TB War Party
mod.summary: A PvP arena system. Players use a lobby machine to create and join arena matches (teams, rounds, entry fee, gear sets), fight inside a built arena, and winners are paid out from the pot. Owners define arenas, gear sets, lobby entry points and the match options players can pick from.
mod.notes: Files are generated on the first server start. Edit them with the server stopped. The doc pages show slightly different file versions than the sample (for example the sample MainConfig is version 5); a few values differ from the doc defaults because the sample is a test server.

files.title: Arena building (objects)
files.summary: Lists every object (walls, buildings) that is placed to build one arena. Normally produced by a converter from a DayZ Editor design rather than typed by hand.

name.label: Arena name
name.help: A descriptive name for the arena. It is only a label and does not change how the arena works; the file name is what other files refer to.

m_SceneObjects[].param1.label: Object class name
m_SceneObjects[].param1.help: Class name of the object to place, for example a prison wall.

m_SceneObjects[].param2[].label: Position coordinate
m_SceneObjects[].param2[].help: One coordinate of the object position (order X, Y, Z).

m_SceneObjects[].param2.label: Object position
m_SceneObjects[].param2.help: World position of the object as three numbers X, Y, Z.

m_SceneObjects[].param3[].label: Rotation angle
m_SceneObjects[].param3[].help: One rotation angle of the object (order X, Y, Z), in degrees.

m_SceneObjects[].param3.label: Object rotation
m_SceneObjects[].param3.help: Rotation of the object as three angles.

m_SceneObjects.label: Arena objects
m_SceneObjects.help: All the objects that make up the arena. Each entry has a class name, a position and a rotation. Hand-editing is error prone; prefer the converter tools.

files.title: Arena match rules
files.summary: One file per arena. Sets the options players can choose when creating a match (players, rounds, fees, penalties), the fixed match rules, countdowns and where each team spawns.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Version number the mod writes into this file so it can upgrade older files. Leave it exactly as it is.
version.risk: Changing it can make the mod reset or reject the file.

isInitialized.label: Initialised marker
isInitialized.help: Set by the mod after it has written the default file. Leave it alone.

arenaObjectsConfigFile.label: Arena layout file
arenaObjectsConfigFile.help: Name of the arena building file (in ArenaBuildingConfigs) to load for this arena. Leave empty if the arena needs no extra objects.

playersCount[].label: Players per match (value)
playersCount[].help: One choice offered to the match creator. Minimum and maximum number of players per match (the doc shows a pair such as 10 and 15).

playersCount.label: Players per match
playersCount.help: Minimum and maximum number of players per match (the doc shows a pair such as 10 and 15).

roundsCount[].label: Rounds per match (value)
roundsCount[].help: One choice offered to the match creator. Minimum and maximum number of rounds the creator can pick.

roundsCount.label: Rounds per match
roundsCount.help: Minimum and maximum number of rounds the creator can pick.

deathPenaltyTimeInSeconds[].label: Death penalty options (value)
deathPenaltyTimeInSeconds[].help: One choice offered to the match creator. Waiting times before a killed player comes back that the creator can choose from.

deathPenaltyTimeInSeconds.label: Death penalty options
deathPenaltyTimeInSeconds.help: Waiting times before a killed player comes back that the creator can choose from.

maxTimePerRoundInMinutes[].label: Round length options (value)
maxTimePerRoundInMinutes[].help: One choice offered to the match creator. Maximum round durations the creator can choose from.

maxTimePerRoundInMinutes.label: Round length options
maxTimePerRoundInMinutes.help: Maximum round durations the creator can choose from.

maxKillsPerRound[].label: Kills-to-win options (value)
maxKillsPerRound[].help: One choice offered to the match creator. Kill counts that end a round, offered to the creator.

maxKillsPerRound.label: Kills-to-win options
maxKillsPerRound.help: Kill counts that end a round, offered to the creator.

startingFee[].label: Entry fee options (value)
startingFee[].help: One choice offered to the match creator. Entry fees (in the server currency) the creator can choose from. The fees form the pot that is paid out to the winners.

startingFee.label: Entry fee options
startingFee.help: Entry fees (in the server currency) the creator can choose from. The fees form the pot that is paid out to the winners.

teamWinRatio[].place.label: Place
teamWinRatio[].place.help: Finishing place this payout applies to (1 = winner).

teamWinRatio[].ratio.label: Share of the pot
teamWinRatio[].ratio.help: Fraction of the pot paid to this place. 0.5 means half.

teamWinRatio.label: Payout by place
teamWinRatio.help: How the pot is split between places. Each entry gives a place and the share of the pot (0 to 1) paid to that team or player.
teamWinRatio.risk: Shares that add up to more than 1 would pay out more than was collected.

enableChangeSides.label: Allow switching sides
enableChangeSides.help: Reserved option for swapping team sides between rounds. The docs describe it as a future feature, so it may have no effect yet.

enableOneLifeMode.label: Offer one-life mode
enableOneLifeMode.help: Lets the match creator choose a mode where a killed player is out for the rest of the round.

enableShowTeamMarker.label: Offer team markers
enableShowTeamMarker.help: Lets the creator choose to show teammates with markers.

enableFriendlyFire.label: Offer friendly fire
enableFriendlyFire.help: Lets the creator choose whether teammates can damage each other.

enableStaminaMode.label: Offer stamina option
enableStaminaMode.help: Lets the creator choose whether stamina drains during the match.

enableShowSpectatorMode.label: Allow spectators
enableShowSpectatorMode.help: Lets people join a match as spectators.

gearSetNames[].label: Gear set name
gearSetNames[].help: Name of a gear set file in GearSets, without .json.

gearSetNames.label: Gear sets offered
gearSetNames.help: Names of the gear sets players can choose, each matching a file in the GearSets folder (without .json). A name with no file will not work.

gearSets.label: Gear sets (internal)
gearSets.help: Filled in by the mod while it runs. Do not edit.

externalPlayersCanEnterArena.label: Outside players may enter
externalPlayersCanEnterArena.help: Reserved option, described in the docs as a future feature. Keep it at its default.

adminCanEnterArena.label: Admins may enter arena
adminCanEnterArena.help: Reserved option for admins entering the arena, described in the docs as a future feature.

enableMultipleGearSets.label: Allow several gear sets
enableMultipleGearSets.help: Lets the match creator pick more than one gear set for a match.

showArenaBoarderPoints.label: Show arena border points
showArenaBoarderPoints.help: Reserved option to show the arena border points. Described in the docs as a future feature.

teamSpawnZones.1[].position[].label: Position coordinate
teamSpawnZones.1[].position[].help: One coordinate of the spawn position (X, Y, Z).

teamSpawnZones.1[].position.label: Team 1 spawn position
teamSpawnZones.1[].position.help: World position X, Y, Z of the spawn zone. Must be inside the arena.

teamSpawnZones.1[].orientation[].label: Orientation angle
teamSpawnZones.1[].orientation[].help: One angle of the spawn orientation, in degrees.

teamSpawnZones.1[].orientation.label: Team 1 spawn facing
teamSpawnZones.1[].orientation.help: Direction players face when they spawn, as three angles.

teamSpawnZones.1[].radius.label: Team 1 spawn radius
teamSpawnZones.1[].radius.help: Players are scattered inside this distance around the spawn position.

teamSpawnZones.1.label: Team 1 spawn zones
teamSpawnZones.1.help: Where players of team 1 appear in the arena. Each entry has a position, an orientation and a radius.

teamSpawnZones.2[].position[].label: Position coordinate
teamSpawnZones.2[].position[].help: One coordinate of the spawn position (X, Y, Z).

teamSpawnZones.2[].position.label: Team 2 spawn position
teamSpawnZones.2[].position.help: World position X, Y, Z of the spawn zone. Must be inside the arena.

teamSpawnZones.2[].orientation[].label: Orientation angle
teamSpawnZones.2[].orientation[].help: One angle of the spawn orientation, in degrees.

teamSpawnZones.2[].orientation.label: Team 2 spawn facing
teamSpawnZones.2[].orientation.help: Direction players face when they spawn, as three angles.

teamSpawnZones.2[].radius.label: Team 2 spawn radius
teamSpawnZones.2[].radius.help: Players are scattered inside this distance around the spawn position.

teamSpawnZones.2.label: Team 2 spawn zones
teamSpawnZones.2.help: Where players of team 2 appear in the arena. Each entry has a position, an orientation and a radius.

teamsCount.label: Teams count (internal)
teamsCount.help: Filled in by the mod while it runs. Do not edit.

playerHealth.label: Player health
playerHealth.help: Health points a player has in the arena.

playerShield.label: Player shield
playerShield.help: Size of the shield that regenerates automatically on top of health.

startCountdown.label: Start countdown
startCountdown.help: Wait before a match starts. The docs give a minimum of 6 seconds.

startNextRoundCountdown.label: Next round countdown
startNextRoundCountdown.help: Wait between rounds. The docs give a minimum of 6 seconds.

endMatchCountdown.label: End of match countdown
endMatchCountdown.help: Wait at the end of a match before players are sent back. The docs give a minimum of 6 seconds.

files.title: Gear set
files.summary: One file per gear set. Lists the items, clothing and weapons (with attachments) every player receives for a match when the set is chosen.

name.label: Gear set name
name.help: Name shown to players in game. The file name is what ArenaMatchConfigs refers to.

items[].type.label: Item class name
items[].type.help: Class name of the item or attachment.

items[].quantityInPercent.label: Quantity
items[].quantityInPercent.help: How full or how much of the item is spawned, from 0 to 100 percent (for example how full a magazine is).

items[].attachments.label: Attachments
items[].attachments.help: Items attached to this one (optics, magazines, suppressors). Same structure as an item.

items[].quickBarEntityShortcut.label: Quick bar slot
items[].quickBarEntityShortcut.help: Quick bar slot for the item. -1 means no quick bar shortcut.

items[].isInHand.label: Held in hand
items[].isInHand.help: 1 puts the item in the player hands at start. Only works for top level items.

items[].attachments[].type.label: Item class name
items[].attachments[].type.help: Class name of the item or attachment.

items[].attachments[].quantityInPercent.label: Quantity
items[].attachments[].quantityInPercent.help: How full or how much of the item is spawned, from 0 to 100 percent (for example how full a magazine is).

items[].attachments[].attachments.label: Nested attachments
items[].attachments[].attachments.help: Attachments of an attachment. Same structure as an item.

items[].attachments[].quickBarEntityShor.label: Quick bar slot
items[].attachments[].quickBarEntityShor.help: Quick bar slot for the item. -1 means no quick bar shortcut.

items[].attachments[].isInHand.label: Held in hand
items[].attachments[].isInHand.help: Ignored on attachments; only top level items can be held in hand.

items.label: Items
items.help: Everything given to the player with this gear set.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Version number the mod writes into this file so it can upgrade older files. Leave it exactly as it is.
version.risk: Changing it can make the mod reset or reject the file.

files.title: Lobby entry point
files.summary: One file per place on the map where players find a lobby machine to open the arena menu, optionally with an NPC.

uniqueName.label: Entry point name
uniqueName.help: Unique name of the entry point. MainConfig lists entry points by file name.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Version number the mod writes into this file so it can upgrade older files. Leave it exactly as it is.
version.risk: Changing it can make the mod reset or reject the file.

coordinate.position[].label: Position coordinate
coordinate.position[].help: One coordinate of the position (X, Y, Z).

coordinate.position.label: Position
coordinate.position.help: World position X, Y, Z of the machine.

coordinate.orientation.label: Orientation
coordinate.orientation.help: Rotation of the machine as three angles.

type.label: Entry point type
type.help: Kind of entry point. TBWPMachine is currently the only one.

useExactPosition.label: Use exact position
useExactPosition.help: 0 drops the machine to the ground automatically. 1 uses the height you give.

enableNpcTrader.label: Spawn an NPC
enableNpcTrader.help: 1 spawns an NPC next to the machine. The two NPC fields below only apply then.

npcType.label: NPC model
npcType.help: Class name of the NPC character model.

npcGearSetName.label: NPC gear set
npcGearSetName.help: Name of a gear set file (GearSets folder) the NPC wears.

files.title: Main settings
files.summary: Turns the arena system on or off, lists the active arenas and lobby entry points, and sets lobby behaviour.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Version number the mod writes into this file so it can upgrade older files. Leave it exactly as it is.
version.risk: Changing it can make the mod reset or reject the file.

isInitialized.label: Initialised marker
isInitialized.help: Set by the mod after it has written the default file. Leave it alone.

isActive.label: Arenas active
isActive.help: 1 lets players create arena matches, 0 switches creation off. Admins can also toggle it from the admin menu.

playerSpawnInMainLobby.label: New players spawn in main lobby
playerSpawnInMainLobby.help: 1 sends new players to the main lobby instead of the map. Players cannot leave the lobby except to enter a match. Needs a server restart.
playerSpawnInMainLobby.risk: Players are held in the lobby until they join a match.

arenaFileNames.label: Active arenas
arenaFileNames.help: Names of the arenas in use, each matching a file name in the arena match folder. Needs a restart.

lobbyEnterPointsNames[].label: Entry point name
lobbyEnterPointsNames[].help: File name (without .json) of a lobby entry point.

lobbyEnterPointsNames.label: Active lobby entry points
lobbyEnterPointsNames.help: Names of the lobby entry points in use, each matching a file in LobbyEnterPoints.

arenas.label: Arenas (internal)
arenas.help: Used internally by the mod. Do not edit.

mainLobbyPosition[].label: Position coordinate
mainLobbyPosition[].help: One coordinate of the main lobby position (X, Y, Z).

mainLobbyPosition.label: Main lobby position
mainLobbyPosition.help: World position X, Y, Z of the main lobby where players are placed when it is used.

playerCanOpenArenaMenuFromEverywhere.label: Arena menu from anywhere
playerCanOpenArenaMenuFromEverywhere.help: 1 lets players open the arena menu anywhere, 0 only at a lobby entry point.

permanentLobbies.label: Permanent lobbies
permanentLobbies.help: Names of lobbies that always exist, each matching a file in a PermanentLobbies folder. Needs a restart.

enableHitAnimation.label: Hit animation
enableHitAnimation.help: Shows a hit animation when a player takes damage in the arena.

disableNpcSpawnInLobbyBuilding.label: No NPCs in lobby building
disableNpcSpawnInLobbyBuilding.help: 1 stops NPCs spawning inside the lobby building.
